description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 5.
